command: set -euo pipefail; echo TIME=$(date -Is); echo LOAD=$(cat /proc/loadavg); awk '/MemAvailable|SwapTotal|SwapFree/ {print}' /proc/meminfo; echo SERVICE=$(systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-buehne.service); echo WINDOWS=$(DISPLAY=:0 xdotool search --name '^FranKenstein -- live$' 2>/dev/null | wc -l); echo LIVE_SHA=$(sha256sum /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual/buehne.html | awk '{print $1}'); echo BODY_RECENT; journalctl --user -u frankenstein-koerperpflege.service --since '-3 min' --no-pager 2>/dev/null | tail -12 || true; echo BODY_RECENT_END
